_comment: THE CONTROL VARIABLE. Every knob that could make one model look better than another
lives here and nowhere else. CONTRACTS.md §2.2: the manifest's `inference` block is
read from this file, overridable only by the flags in §1.2. Editing anything under
`inference` changes verdicts -> MAJOR harness version bump, and runs across that bump
are not comparable. `endpoint` is deliberately absent: it is a property of the machine,
not of the experiment, and is resolved by run.sh (--endpoint / $HARNESS_ENDPOINT).
`agent_config_sha256` in the manifest is the sha256 of this file's bytes.
`inference.seed` is the BASE seed: the held-constant that goes into the manifest,
identical for every model, suite and run. The seed actually sent for one attempt is
`base_seed + pass_idx` (agent.py attempt_seed()), so the passes aggregate.py bootstraps
over are genuine repeats instead of the same seed re-sent at temperature 0.0. Both
numbers are recorded per attempt in the record's `sampling` block.
